passwordComplexity: Include at least one letter and one number.
tagFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
keyFormat: Use lowercase letters and numbers, joined by single - or _ (2–64 characters).
nothingToChange: Nothing to save: change something first.
reorderMismatch: The list changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
optionsRequired: Add at least one active option.
openBeforeClose: Closing time must be after opening time.
oneOpenDay: Keep at least one day open.
emailDomain: Enter a domain such as hamad.qa (without @).
publicEmailDomain: Public mail providers such as gmail.com can't belong to an organisation.
webhookUrl: Enter a full https:// webhook URL.
atRiskPercent: Use a whole percentage from 1 to 99.
notFound: This item no longer exists. Reload and choose again.
skillArchived: This skill is archived — restore it first.
phone: Enter an international number starting with + and the country code, e.g. +974 4000 0000.
timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
